MainThreadRef.summary.en:
A `MainThreadRef` is a ref that can only be accessed on the main thread. It is used to preserve
states between main thread function calls.
The data saved in `current` property of the `MainThreadRef` can be read and written in
multiple main thread functions.
MainThreadRef.summary.text:
`MainThreadRef` 是一种只能在主线程访问的 ref，
用于在主线程函数调用之间保存状态。
保存在 `MainThreadRef` 的 `current` 属性中的数据，
可以在多个主线程函数中读写。

createPortal.summary.en:
Renders children into a different ReactLynx element identified by a
`NodesRef` (e.g. from `ref={setX}` or `lynx.createSelectorQuery()`).
createPortal.summary.text:
将 children 渲染到另一个 ReactLynx 元素中，该元素由
`NodesRef`（例如来自 `ref={setX}` 或 `lynx.createSelectorQuery()`）标识。

createPortal.remarks.en:
Context still flows across the portal boundary, and state updates inside the
portal behave like they do in any other component. A few behaviors differ
from `react-dom`:

- Events do not bubble along the React tree. ReactLynx follows Preact's
  approach, which has no synthetic event system, so events follow the actual
  element structure of the page.
- The portaled subtree renders on the background thread only, and does not
  participate in main-thread first-screen rendering.
- Mounting across pages or across native containers is not supported.
createPortal.remarks.text:
Context 仍会跨越 portal 边界传递，portal 内的状态更新也与其他组件中的表现一致。
但有几点行为与 `react-dom`
不同：

- 事件不会沿 React 树冒泡。ReactLynx 沿用 Preact 的做法，
  没有合成事件系统，
  因此事件遵循页面实际的元素结构。
- portal 中的子树仅在后台线程渲染，
  不参与主线程首屏渲染。
- 不支持跨页面或跨 native 容器挂载。

createPortal.returns.en:
A `ReactNode` placeholder to include in the JSX at the call site;
the rendered output goes into `container`.
createPortal.returns.text:
需要在调用处放入 JSX 中的 `ReactNode` 占位符；
渲染结果会输出到 `container` 中。

markFirstScreenSyncReady.summary.en:
Mark the first screen as ready to sync when `firstScreenSyncTiming` is `'manual'`.

The main thread holds the UI control until this is called, so the handover timing to
the background thread (for hydration) is fully controlled by the user. It can be called
from both threads (a background-thread call is forwarded to the main thread), is a no-op
unless `firstScreenSyncTiming` is `'manual'`, and has no further effect once called.
markFirstScreenSyncReady.summary.text:
当 `firstScreenSyncTiming` 为 `'manual'` 时，将首屏标记为可同步。

在调用此方法之前，主线程会一直持有 UI 控制权，
因此向后台线程移交（用于 hydration）的时机完全由用户控制。
它可以在两个线程中调用（后台线程的调用会被转发到主线程），
仅在 `firstScreenSyncTiming` 为 `'manual'` 时生效，且首次调用之后再次调用不会产生任何效果。

runOnBackground.summary.en: `runOnBackground` allows triggering js functions on the background thread asynchronously.
runOnBackground.summary.text: `runOnBackground` 用于在后台线程上异步触发 JS 函数。

runOnBackground.returns.en: A function. Calling which with the arguments to be passed to the js function to trigger it on the background thread. This function returns a promise that resolves to the return value of the js function.
runOnBackground.returns.text: 一个函数。以要传给该 JS 函数的参数调用它，即可在后台线程上触发该 JS 函数。该函数返回一个 Promise，其 resolve 值为该 JS 函数的返回值。

runOnMainThread.summary.en: `runOnMainThread` allows triggering main thread functions on the main thread asynchronously.
runOnMainThread.summary.text: `runOnMainThread` 用于在主线程上异步触发主线程函数。

runOnMainThread.returns.en: A function. Calling which with the arguments to be passed to the main thread function to trigger it on the main thread. This function returns a promise that resolves to the return value of the main thread function.
runOnMainThread.returns.text: 一个函数。以要传给该主线程函数的参数调用它，即可在主线程上触发该主线程函数。该函数返回一个 Promise，其 resolve 值为该主线程函数的返回值。

useLynxGlobalEventListener.summary.en: `useLynxGlobalEventListener` helps you `addListener` as early as possible.

useMainThreadRef.summary.en:
Create A `MainThreadRef`.

A `MainThreadRef` is a ref that can only be accessed on the main thread. It is used to preserve
states between main thread function calls.
The data saved in `current` property of the `MainThreadRef` can be read and written in
multiple main thread functions.

It is a hook and it should only be called at the top level of your component.
useMainThreadRef.summary.text:
创建一个 `MainThreadRef`。

`MainThreadRef` 是一种只能在主线程访问的 ref，
用于在主线程函数调用之间保存状态。
保存在 `MainThreadRef` 的 `current` 属性中的数据，
可以在多个主线程函数中读写。

它是一个 Hook，只应在组件的顶层调用。

withInitDataInState.summary.en:
Higher-Order Component (HOC) that injects `initData` into the state of the given class component.

This HOC checks if the provided component is a class component. If it is, it wraps the component
and injects the `initData` into its state. It also adds a listener
to update the state when data changes, and removes the listener when the component unmounts.
withInitDataInState.summary.text:
高阶组件（HOC），将 `initData` 注入到给定类组件的 state 中。

该 HOC 会检查传入的组件是否为类组件。如果是，则包装该组件，
并将 `initData` 注入其 state。同时它会添加一个监听器，
在数据变化时更新 state，并在组件卸载时移除该监听器。

withInitDataInState.returns.en:
The original component if it is not a class component, otherwise a new class component
         with `initData` injection and state update functionality.
withInitDataInState.returns.text:
若传入的不是类组件，则返回原组件；否则返回一个新的类组件，
         该组件具备 `initData` 注入和 state 更新功能。
